method: the journal's own pages read by hand on 2026-11-07 (the home page, /articles, /issues, /search, /for-authors/, /special-collections/, /editorial-board/, /policies/ and /about/); each feature marked against Verse's page (/journal/) by the words that page carries, so a builder can check the mark on the live page

features.name: Latest articles with title, authors, date and volume
features.detail: a heading on / (Latest Research)
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows "Latest papers", "Volume" and "DOI"

features.name: The abstract of each article
features.detail: a paragraph under each article on /
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows the abstract of each paper

features.name: Browse the article archive
features.detail: the Articles menu and the articles page
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ lists the papers with their DOIs and searches the whole archive

features.name: Search articles
features.detail: a heading on /search
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows "Search the whole archive"

features.name: Issues by volume
features.detail: a heading on /issues
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows the volumes and the papers of each

features.name: Special collections by theme
features.detail: a heading on /special-collections/ (Snowball Earth, Metal Isotopes, the Kröner memorial collection)
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows "Collections" and eight themed searches

features.name: A DOI for each article
features.detail: on every article page
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows "DOI 10.2475"

features.name: The PDF of each article
features.detail: a download on every article page

features.name: The reference list of each article
